summary:
# 今日社区动态（deepseek-flash | 2026-11-25 ~ 2026-11-27）

- ✨ arm64 引入最小 DWARF CFI 展开器，用户态与内核态栈回溯更可靠，支撑性能剖析（[Architecture](#subsystem-Architecture)）
- ⚡ 移除 cpu_down 的全局 stop_machine，改由各架构自行同步文本与页表，缩短 CPU 下线延迟（[Architecture](#subsystem-Architecture)）
- ⚡ 混合平台 amd-pstate 增加容量感知调度，由 x86 CPPC/HFI 上报各核能力指导调频与放置（[Power Management](#subsystem-Power%20Management)）
- ⚡ 统一响应时间管理，扩展 PELT/uclamp 与 schedutil 联动，降低调度延迟（[Scheduling](#subsystem-Scheduling)）
- ⚡ vfs 引入 inode 迭代方法，替代遍历时反复取引用，降低大规模 inode 扫描开销（[Filesystem & Storage](#subsystem-Filesystem%20%26%20Storage)）

## Drivers
- `perf` mmc core 忙轮询延时改为按状态自适应，减少固定延时造成的等待开销。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/ebdff46271d3418483ddae57e31d1cba@zeshmbx09.spreadtrum.com/)
- 新增 LG V60 ThinQ 设备树，并引入 SW43103 面板与 SW42902 触摸驱动。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125032802.8460-1-rofikcoga@gmail.com/)
- 新增 fwnode 属性遍历接口，使 gpiolib-shared 以 fwnode 为中心解析属性。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-fwnode-for-each-prop-v4-0-d4b370ecfd52@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- 默认 file_operations 助手中挂接 drm_show_fdinfo，驱动可删掉重复 fops 定义。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-drm-fops-show-fdinfo-v1-0-7cb1d1a5d6ef@chromium.org/)
- 重构 drm_writeback_connector，解耦连接器与写回逻辑，简化 amdgpu/komeda 等实现。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126042835.436307-1-suraj.kandpal@intel.com/)
- 新增 DRM bridge 热插拔与 HDMI CEC 辅助框架，桥接芯片可独立上报连接状态。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-drm-bridge-hotplug-v4-0-822722850492@bootlin.com/)
- regmap 统一处理超出 val_bits 宽度的值，避免写入被静默截断，并补 KUnit 覆盖。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-regmap-kunit-val-bits-v2-0-81db3b79cd3f@gmail.com/)
- 新增 drm_fb_dma_get_gem_clipped_addr，替换 imx/sun4i 中手写的裁剪计算。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126071314.253890-1-wenst@chromium.org/)
- 平台设备支持按 reg-names 查找命名内存资源，并补充 ACPI DSD 说明。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126030526.3911143-1-yubowen8@huawei.com/)
- `other` 允许固件要求卡常驻时在系统挂起期间保持 MMC 卡供电，新增 DT 属性与 core 支持。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125182053.3915833-1-kamal.dasu@broadcom.com/)
- 另有 71 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126072220.4496-1-sreekuttan2156239@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125181005.3683575-1-hengyul@cs.unc.edu/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126084233.17381-1-qiang.zhang@linux.dev/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126093106.1345825-1-linmag7@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125140251.384361-1-andriy.shevchenko@linux.intel.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-feat_move_i915_helper-v2-0-aa04d39bc415@bootlin.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126065310.3451-1-sreekuttan2156239@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126061910.2840-1-sreekuttan2156239@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-alsa-timer-slave-flags-v2-1-8e07a536fea3@nitrohex.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125073009.3091-1-sreekuttan2156239@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126085906.814373-1-orgads@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125184750.57866-1-apokusinski01@gmail.com/) 等 71 项

## Architecture
- `perf` 统一各架构 set_memory/change_page_attr 实现，抽出通用核心，减少 arm/arm64/loongarch 重复代码 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-generic-set-memory-v0-1-v2-0-723f1e33c3d8@kernel.org/)
- `perf` arm64 引入最小 DWARF CFI 展开器，用户态与内核态栈回溯更可靠，支撑性能剖析 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125061523.1540234-1-irogers@google.com/)
- 新增 Toshiba TC9564 时钟与复位驱动，供车载以太网桥接芯片使用 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125202141.1288493-1-elder@riscstar.com/)
- `perf` 统一 kcov/gcov 覆盖率框架，新增 Clang 源码级覆盖率与 MC/DC 分支条件度量 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125020603.3934222-1-sashal@kernel.org/)
- `perf` `other` 通过 thermal 通知在温度漂移时重新校准 QCOM PCIe PHY，避免链路降速 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-glymur-thermal-fix-v1-0-b93a9feae156@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- `perf` 为 Exynos7885 添加 USB3 DRD PHY 与 DWC3 支持，使该 SoC 具备 USB 功能 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125145458.2594179-1-virag.david003@gmail.com/)
- `perf` 新增 Google Laguna CPM 时钟控制器驱动，支持该 SoC 的时钟与复位 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125000349.3385325-1-briannorris@chromium.org/)
- `perf` `bugfix` 修复 arm/arm64 hw_breakpoint 在 perf 事件触发时的空指针解引用（稳定分支回填） [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126043458.2394658-1-luogengkun@huaweicloud.com/)
- `perf` 新增 PCIe 接收端 lane margining debugfs 接口，便于评估链路信号裕量 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-pcie-link-endpoints-v8-0-19d49c17c05f@google.com/)
- 移除 cpu_down 的全局 stop_machine，改由各架构自行同步文本与页表，缩短 CPU 下线延迟 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125222230.22508-1-frederic@kernel.org/)
- 另有 91 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-halliday-dts-v3-0-5c8311c0b70b@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126155339.1349218-1-arnd@kernel.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125153911.106793-1-fuad.tabba@linux.dev/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-6768-init-v1-0-abc364a2447e@protonmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-sm7250-v15-0-492014ec0a52@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-glymur-v12-0-5c34dfd73fc2@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-jshekhar-v3-dcp-v3-0-f1e9d7505039@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-iep2-v5-0-3deac0976f10@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125024426.3464050-1-justin.he@arm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-dfi-clocks-and-rk3576-support-v3-0-0f33c1b8df48@collabora.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-rk3576-otp-cpuid-mac-v5-0-b3125c9a5fc8@flipper.net/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-netrani-interconnect-v2-v2-0-4eab92854137@krgm.moe/) 等 91 项

## Networking
- `perf` 为 S32G 增加 SerDes DT 绑定、DTS 及 stmmac/PCIe/PHY 配套，支持多协议高速接口。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-s32g_serdes-v4-0-3bfe0589be8d@oss.nxp.com/)
- `perf` `other` 为 Cortina CS7542 增加 IPv4 硬件 flowtable offload。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-almondplus-offload-rfc-v1-0-703175c6340c@gmail.com/)
- 为 AMT 增加 IPv6 外层传输，扩展网关部署场景。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125191450.2497936-1-omar@blockcast.net/)
- `perf` 调整 veth 发送队列唤醒/停止时机，缓解背压下的丢包与空转。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125152311.805325-1-simon.schippers@tu-dortmund.de/)
- `perf` 整理 page_pool 参数注释，删除过时的 fast/slow 表述。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125184640.2407270-1-takano32@gmail.com/)
- 拒绝加入无属主家族的组播组，避免误加入与资源泄漏。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125144514.2717012-1-anilkaushikwireless@gmail.com/)
- `bugfix` 释放 neighbour 前先停 T20 定时器，修复释放后定时器访问。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125103153.53012-1-f3lix.dev@gmx.de/)
- 为 stmmac 编程 FSM 超时定时器。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125111929.3395740-1-zxyan0222@gmail.com/)
- 为 Sparx5 增加 L3 路由 offload 的 router legs。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-sparx5_l3_routing-v4-0-86a9bac28fcf@microchip.com/)
- 新增 mlx5_nodnic 驱动，支持无 DRAM 的 NVIDIA NIC function。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126182448.707782-1-tariqt@nvidia.com/)
- 另有 100 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126025015.10416-1-yanhaishuang@cmss.chinamobile.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-tcp-l3mdev-exempt-ports-v2-0-b920f3ff8f5e@nexthop.ai/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-for-upstream-le-conn-params-rpa-v5-0-b7f015a35023@podgorny.cz/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-srv6_flavors_endx-v5-0-4d8232eec404@kylinos.cn/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795573672.git.kyuwoncho18@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125020835.1132797-1-jianbol@nvidia.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125043847.885053-1-piyus@iiitd.ac.in/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126111516.317545-1-ralf@mandelbit.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126015239.6038-1-25031212351@stu.xidian.edu.cn/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/pm-bluetooth-objects-candidate-0218-followup-v2-88edfec8c72ed860e626-0@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125043805.883952-1-piyus@iiitd.ac.in/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126090445.1523-1-luob87709@gmail.com/) 等 100 项

## Clocks & Timers
- 新增 `strprefix` 字符串前缀判断接口并修正其实现缺陷，替换 clk-socfpga 与 driver core 属性匹配中的手写比较，减少重复字符串解析 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795695151.git.alx@kernel.org/)
- 新增 Cortina CS7542 全局时钟、复位与 pinctrl 驱动及 binding，使该 SoC 外设可正常供钟与引脚复用 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-cs7542-syscon-v4-0-3337bb0d3b48@gmail.com/)
- 在 r9a06g032 时钟驱动中内建复位控制器以释放 MII 转换器复位，同步扩展 sysctrl binding 与 DTS [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-rzn1-miic-resets-v4-0-4f73af81d779@reliablecontrols.com/)
- `bugfix` 修正 sam9x7 GMAC TSU 时钟配置并同步 DTS，避免 TSU 计时偏差或时钟使能失败 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126093606.13271-1-mihai.sain@microchip.com/)
- 新增 Qualcomm Netrani 的 GCC 与 RPMH 时钟控制器驱动、dt-bindings 及 binding 文档，补齐该平台时钟树 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-netrani-clock-v3-v3-0-9b19d320f422@krgm.moe/)
- 新增 Glymur LPASS 音频低功耗子系统时钟控制器驱动与 binding，支持音频相关时钟的开关与门控 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125131757.1163466-1-srinivas.kandagatla@oss.qualcomm.com/)

## Power Management
- `perf` 在混合平台上为 amd-pstate 增加容量感知调度，由 x86 CPPC/HFI 上报各核能力供调频与放置使用 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125172031.741740-1-Vishal.Badole@amd.com/)
- `other` power supply 核心为每个 supply 的 epc_sem 分配独立 lockdep class，消除多实例间的假锁依赖告警 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-power-supply-epc-lockdep-key-v1-1-c8a41b8a4470@gmail.com/)
- `perf` cpufreq 核心在某个策略重新启用 boost 时保留全局 boost 状态，避免其他策略的加速能力被关掉 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126110903.3747240-1-jiangtianfeng@linux.alibaba.com/)
- 新增 Qualcomm PM4125 SMBLite 充电器驱动及 DT 绑定，补齐该 PMIC 的充电管理支持 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-smblite-charger-for-pm4125-v2-0-20656509518b@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- 另有 5 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-netrani-pm6450-v1-v3-0-2343209bbf4c@krgm.moe/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/ac17f1db-e8db-41d7-922b-6cb32c7096ec@web.de/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126005321.71799-1-iasnezhkov@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125173959.2198116-1-christian.loehle@arm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125234822.94684-1-iasnezhkov@gmail.com/)

## Virtualization
- KVM VMX 新增 secondary VM-exit controls 支持，扩展退出控制以承载更多 VM-exit 条件 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126022743.4082392-1-sohil.mehta@intel.com/)
- x86 PMU 在嵌套切换时统一延迟重编程，省去 guest/host 计数反复切换的开销 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125182703.1694998-1-yosry@kernel.org/)
- x86 模拟器支持 cmpxchg16b，可正确模拟 16 字节原子比较交换指令 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126060515.2198-1-sarunkod@amd.com/)
- virtio 新增 Qualcomm DCP 传输封装，含 YAML 绑定、新 device ID 与 virtio_mmio 扩展 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-jshekhar-qcom-virtio-dcp-v1-0-7b49bda74916@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- `bugfix` nVMX 修复 Windows guest 的嵌套 APICv 模拟缺陷，涉及 SMM/寄存器同步路径 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125155819.408795-1-mlevitsk@redhat.com/)
- `bugfix` 上述嵌套 APICv 修复的 v4 版本，已被 v5 取代 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125052139.362046-1-mlevitsk@redhat.com/)
- `perf` mshv 映射 guest GPA 前先做 pre-commit，减少映射失败与回滚开销 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125001054.1057035-1-mrathor@linux.microsoft.com/)
- `other` nVMX 若模拟抢占定时器截止时间已过则立即到期，避免延迟注入 guest [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125134942.60776-1-amirmohammad.eftekhar@cispa.de/)
- `bugfix` x86 LAPIC 在 LVT0 被屏蔽期间不再丢失已锁存的 ExtINT，并新增 selftest [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/OS3PR01MB1025133EF63D307090C7718DEE7422@OS3PR01MB10251.jpnprd01.prod.outlook.com/)
- `perf` `bugfix` tdx-guest 改为轮询等待 Quote 完成，修复等待逻辑并加快结果取回 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-tdx-guest-quote-poll-v4-0-d89f26854b88@flashbots.net/)
- 另有 2 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126081644.45517-1-alexevgmart@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126081631.45468-1-alexevgmart@gmail.com/)

## Filesystem & Storage
- phy core 增加 bulk 获取/使能辅助接口，供 AHCI 与 Cadence PCIe 复用 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125043639.249525-1-inochiama@gmail.com/)
- `perf` vfs 引入 inode 迭代方法，替代遍历时反复取引用，降低大规模 inode 扫描开销 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125091157.1822521-1-huangsj@hygon.cn/)
- ufs core 为 PA TFS/FEC 错误计数增加 debugfs 节点，便于链路诊断 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125113435.1426680-1-powenkao@google.com/)
- `perf` cephfs 拆分 mdsc->mutex 竞争点，提升多客户端并发元数据操作吞吐 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-ceph-mdsc-mutex-optimization-v8-0-5bb2299ef4ee@clyso.com/)
- `perf` `other` xfs fsync 在后续 flush 已完成时跳过重复刷写，减少日志与缓冲写回 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-xfs-fsync-flush-seq-v3-1-830f5dd79fae@samsung.com/)
- `perf` `other` exec 路径去掉 proc 与 perf 事件中的两处可睡眠点，缩短 exec 临界区 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-work-exec-update_lock-leftovers-v1-0-1024b26792bc@kernel.org/)
- `perf` `bugfix` fat 读写 FAT 表项时持有缓冲区锁，避免并发读写不一致 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125034336.3724504-1-yanghaoming@kaihong.com/)
- fileattr API 新增 f*_xflags_rw/ro_mask 标志，支持按读写分别设定属性掩码 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126163114.403846-1-koray.fra@gmail.com/)
- ceph 跨客户端串行化 O_APPEND 写，避免追加写互相覆盖 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261126-ceph-append-excl-v2-0-e8707d123d77@clyso.com/)
- ocfs2 直接 I/O 从 buffer_head 迁移到 iomap，统一走 iomap 路径 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125154626.22335-1-heming.zhao@suse.com/)
